headline:
Before you join,
ask this.
body:
A club can be a great fit.
The details still matter.
questions: Registration, kit, travel, tournament and payment terms.
Training days, travel distance and the match schedule.
Age, experience, playing goals and how players are supported.
Ask about evaluation, availability and next steps.
cta: Save this for your next club conversation.
caption:
The badge looks good. Now ask about the week-to-week reality.

Before you commit, check the full cost, the training and match schedule, whether the group fits the player, and what the club’s next step actually is. A trial or evaluation may be offered; ask rather than assuming.

There’s no single right answer for every family. A program that works for your schedule and goals is worth finding.

Use Cancha to build a shortlist, then talk directly with the club.

headline:
A field nearby.
A better starting point.
body:
Explore local venues.
Check the access rules first.
cta: Find the pitch. Confirm the plan.
caption:
A field on a map doesn’t always mean you can walk on and play.

Our Broward place profiles bring together official venue information, location notes and access restrictions. Some facilities need a permit or are tied to a club or school.

Start with places like Boggs Park, Weston Regional Park or Pine Trails Park, then read the profile and confirm the rules with the operator. These are venue profiles, not scheduled pickup games.

The map groups listings at city centers. Open a profile for the actual location and directions.
